abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may remove 1 damage counter from this Pokémon. This Pokémon is now Asleep. This power can't be used if this Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Continuous Tumble
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Scary Face
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, until the end of your opponent's next turn the Defending Pokémon can't attack or retreat.

attacks.name: Threaten
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, look at your opponent's hand. If they have any Trainer cards there, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into their deck.

attacks.name: Antler Swipe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage to the Defending Pokémon (don't apply Weakness or Resistance). If tails and your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Energy Healing
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from this Pokémon for each Energy attached to it. If it has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Doubleslap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Energy Plant
attacks.text: Search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Trip Over
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

attacks.name: Blot
attacks.text: If there are any damage counters on this Pokémon, remove 1 of them.

attacks.name: Freezing Breath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Overrun
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of them and this attack does 10 damage to it. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Rage
attacks.text: This attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Bear Hug
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Rend
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon already has any damage counters on it, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If not, this attack does 40 damage.

attacks.name: Healing Dust
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon. If a Pokémon has fewer damage counters than the number of heads, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Miracle Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Special Condition (Asleep, Burned, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned). The Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition.

attacks.name: Double Spin
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Supersonic
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Magnetic Pull
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spin Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Entangling Thread
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Poison Horn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Triple Smash
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Sound Waves
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Flitter
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

attacks.name: Poison Spray
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.name: Ancient Ruins
cards.text: Once during each player's turn (before they attack), if they have not played a Supporter card, that player may reveal their hand to their opponent. If that player reveals their hand and there is no Supporter card there, that player draws a card.

cards.name: Relic Hunter
cards.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Supporter and/or Stadium cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Crystal Shard
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card. As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, that Pokémon's type (color) is Colorless. If that Pokémon attacks, discard this card at the end of the turn.

cards.name: Desert Shaman
cards.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck and draw up to 4 cards. Your opponent does the same.

cards.name: Fast Ball
cards.text: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal an Evolution card. Show that card to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other revealed cards into your deck. (If you don't reveal an Evolution card, shuffle all the revealed cards back into your deck.)

cards.name: Hyper Potion
cards.text: Choose 1 of your Pokémon. Discard 1 or 2 basic Energy cards attached to that Pokémon. If you discarded 1 Energy card, remove up to 3 damage counters from that Pokémon. If you discarded 2 Energy cards, remove up to 5 damage counters from that Pokémon. (Skyridge's own card, not a print of the newer Hyper Potion.)

cards.name: Miracle Sphere α
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Evolved Fire, Lightning, or Fighting Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Fire Force
attacks.text: If the Pokémon using this attack has Fire and Lightning basic Energy cards attached to it, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If the Pokémon using this attack has Fire and Fighting basic Energy cards attached to it, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage and remove 3 damage counters from the Pokémon this card is attached to.

cards.name: Miracle Sphere β
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Evolved Fire, Water, or Psychic Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Freezing Force
attacks.text: If the Pokémon using this attack has Fire and Water basic Energy cards attached to it, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Burned. If the Pokémon using this attack has Water and Psychic basic Energy cards attached to it, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon, if any, and your opponent shuffles that card into their deck.

cards.name: Miracle Sphere γ
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Evolved Grass, Water, or Lightning Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Thunder Force
attacks.text: If the Pokémon using this attack has Grass and Lightning basic Energy cards attached to it, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned. If the Pokémon using this attack has Water and Lightning basic Energy cards attached to it, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage and lets you put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Mirage Stadium
cards.text: Whenever a player tries to retreat a Pokémon during their turn, that player flips a coin. If heads, that player retreats that Pokémon (and discards Energy normally). If tails, that Pokémon can't retreat this turn (the player doesn't discard any Energy).

cards.name: Mystery Plate α
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Desert Burn
attacks.text: If your opponent has 5 or more Prizes, search your deck for a Trainer card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. If your opponent has only 1 Prize, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned, Paralyzed, and Poisoned.

cards.name: Mystery Plate β
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Stone Crush
attacks.text: If your opponent has 5 or more Prizes, draw 3 cards. If your opponent has only 1 Prize, choose 2 Energy cards attached to the Defending Pokémon (1 if there is only 1). Your opponent shuffles those cards into their deck.

cards.name: Mystery Plate γ
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Retro Cave
attacks.text: If your opponent has 5 or more Prizes, shuffle your hand into your deck and then draw 6 cards. If your opponent has exactly 2 Prizes, choose 1 of your opponent's Evolved Pokémon. Your opponent puts the top card on that Evolved Pokémon on the bottom of their deck. (This counts as devolving that Pokémon.)

cards.name: Mystery Plate δ
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon in play. That Pokémon may use this card's attack instead of its own. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

attacks.name: Healing Oasis
attacks.text: If your opponent has 5 or more Prizes, search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If your opponent has exactly 2 Prizes, remove all damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.name: Mystery Zone
cards.text: Once during each player's turn (before they attack), if that player has an Evolution card in their hand, they may search their deck for a basic Energy card, show it to their opponent, and put it into their hand. Then that player chooses an Evolution card from their hand, shows it to their opponent, and puts it into their deck. That player shuffles their deck afterward.

cards.name: Oracle
cards.text: Choose 2 cards from your deck and shuffle the rest of your deck. Put the chosen cards on top of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Star Piece
cards.text: Attach this card to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. If that Pokémon is Knocked Out, discard this card. At any time between turns, if the Pokémon this card is attached to is Benched and has 2 or more damage counters on it, search your deck for an Evolution card that Pokémon evolves into and put it on top of that Pokémon. (This counts as evolving that Pokémon.) Shuffle your deck afterward. Then, discard this card.

cards.name: Underground Lake
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, that player may put an Omanyte or a Kabuto card from their discard pile onto their Bench. (Cards put on the Bench this way are considered Basic Pokémon.)

cards.name: Bounce Energy
cards.text: This card provides [C][C] Energy. You can attach this card only to your Pokémon that has basic Energy cards attached to it. When you play this card from your hand and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon, return a basic Energy card attached to that Pokémon to your hand.

cards.name: Cyclone Energy
cards.text: This card provides [C] Energy. When you play this card from your hand and attach it to your Active Pokémon, your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Retro Energy
cards.text: This card provides [C] Energy. When you play this card from your hand and attach it to 1 of your Evolved Pokémon, you may remove up to 2 damage counters from that Pokémon and discard the top card from it. (This counts as devolving it.)

abilities.name: Crystal Type
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Grass, Water, or Psychic basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, this Pokémon's type (color) becomes the same as that type of Energy until the end of the turn.

attacks.name: Empathic Healing
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from this Pokémon and each Pokémon that's the same type (color) as this Pokémon (your ruling: both players' Pokémon).

attacks.name: Mind Bend
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

abilities.name: Crystal Type
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Fire, Lightning, or Fighting basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, this Pokémon's type (color) becomes the same as that type of Energy until the end of the turn.

attacks.name: Fireblast
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Tail
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

abilities.name: Crystal Type
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Grass, Fire, or Psychic basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, this Pokémon's type (color) becomes the same as that type of Energy until the end of the turn.

attacks.name: Poison Flame
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Squared Attack
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

abilities.name: Crystal Type
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Grass, Fire, or Fighting basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, this Pokémon's type (color) becomes the same as that type of Energy until the end of the turn.

attacks.name: Earth Bomb
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 20 damage to itself. This attack also does 10 damage to each Benched Pokémon (yours and your opponent's). (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Crystal Type
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Fire, Water, or Lightning basic Energy card from your hand to Ho-oh, Ho-oh's type (color) becomes the same as that type of Energy until the end of the turn.

attacks.name: Scalding Steam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to Ho-oh and flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned.

abilities.name: Crystal Type
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Water, Lightning, or Fighting basic Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, this Pokémon's type (color) becomes the same as that type of Energy until the end of the turn.

attacks.name: Draining Cut
attacks.text: Remove a damage counter from this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Triple Cutter
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.
